body.statement: For any \(S,T\subseteq[n]\), all projectors below act on the fixed space \(\mathbb R^n\), and \[\left\|P_{\operatorname{span}\{A^{-\top}e_j:j\in T\}}P_{\operatorname{span}\{A^{-\top}e_j:j\in S\}^{\perp}}\right\|_{\mathrm{op}}=0\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad T\subseteq S.\] For every witness label \(i\in T\setminus S\), the left-hand side is at least \(\rho_i(G)=1/(\|A^{-\top}e_i\|_2\|Ae_i\|_2)=1/(\|H^{\top}e_i\|_2\|Ge_i\|_2)>0\), and hence at least \(\rho^{\ast}(G)\). The source's printed quantity \(\gamma^{\ast}(G)=\min_i\|H_{i,:}\|_2\|G_{:,i}\|_2\) is a norm product, not this reciprocal lower bound.
body.justification: The graph transcript needs a correct zero-versus-positive projector characterization under nonorthogonal mixing.
body.gap: The printed norm-product expression in the closest source can exceed one and a subset-pseudoinverse identity used with it is false; this proposition uses dual vectors and actual projector geometry.
body.consumer: It prevents false edge decisions in the population proof and supplies the geometric quantity to be enclosed numerically.
